name: gap-plugin
description: Detects drift between proposal documents and their implementation (gap_plugin/, scripts/gap_scan.py), then walks a human through resolving each disputed claim. Codex-native install.

interface.longDescription: Runs scripts/gap_scan.py, then walks a human through each disputed claim with the retrieved evidence, recording decisions and routing to doc updates or implementation follow-up.
